findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The inspector observed the following non food contact surfaces of equipment to have accumulated soil: The Nestle glass top ice cream freezer (frost), the bottom of Dairy cooler in back stock, bottom of Dairy cooler in store, bottom of cold drink cooler under milk in store. Clean and maintain these areas clean for the next routine inspection. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
